metadata.name: Phase — Software architecture
metadata.insumos: current/srs/SRS.md, current/base-de-datos/DATABASE_DESIGN.md, current/backlog/BACKLOG.md when it exists

prompt.objetivo: Describe the architecture that satisfies the current requirements. The depth matches the product, not the length of a template.

hacer.paso: Start from the current stack. If it does not exist, propose one option and one alternative, with the reason and the decision left open in validar mode.
Follow the index in formats/sad/SAD.md. Use C4 context and containers. Components only when there is more than one module with a different responsibility.
Document the decisions that are hard to reverse: style, persistence, boundaries, authentication, errors, and deployment. Each decision has context, options, and consequences.
Bind quality characteristics to measurable scenarios. Do not copy all of ISO/IEC 25010:2023.
Define the folder and module structure the archetype will have to respect. If the repository already has one, that structure is the base.
Risks and technical debt are concrete. A generic risk does not count.

no_hacer.regla: Do not design microservices, a message broker, or a cache because a sample document had them.
Do not contradict the current data model. If the architecture needs to change it, write the change as a proposal and do not edit the current document.
Do not declare the architecture validated without a review.
